hook: The Australia Jillaroos haven't achieved a bigger margin than 118 points in team history.

sections.voiceover: The Australia Jillaroos haven't achieved a bigger margin than 118 points in team history.
b_roll: stadium photo of rugby league arena with scoreboard

sections.voiceover: On November 1, 2026, the Australia Jillaroos crushed Wales at Commbank Stadium. Jaime Chapman crossed for 6 tries during the relentless victory. Which opponent surrendered 92 points to Australia in 2022?
b_roll: graphic highlighting 6 tries by Jaime Chapman

sections.voiceover: Except Australia eclipsed that 92 point win with an 118 point margin.
b_roll: bar chart comparing past record margins

sections.voiceover: The score of 124 to 6 delivered the biggest margin in Jillaroos history. Australia kicked 20 goals to seal dominance during the match.
b_roll: scoreboard graphic showing 124 to 6 final score
timeline chart of historic World Cup margins

sections.voiceover: Australia proved why 124 points belongs in the record books.
b_roll: trophy icon and final statistical record graphic
